node.title: Re^3: How to modify an XML file using XML::DOM
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [ankit.tayal560],

You don't need the open and close - printToFile does all the handling of writing to the file for you.

As for the error message, it appears you've come across a bug - or at least a deficiency in the documentation - of [doc://XML::DOM]. The document needs to have an "XMLDecl" set. You can do this for example via: $doc->setXMLDecl($doc->createXMLDecl('1.0','UTF-8'));

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
